author: Hermes
question: A series RLC circuit has R = 10 ohm, L = 100 mH and C = 100 microF. What is its resonant frequency?
solution: Resonance when inductive and capacitive reactances cancel: f0 = 1/(2 x pi x sqrt(LC)) = 1/(2 x pi x sqrt(0.1 x 100e-6)) = 1/(2 x pi x 3.162e-3) = 50.3 Hz. Topic (resonance) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
